thread:
Anya: Kicking off the green deployment now. Rolling traffic in steps 0->10->25->50->100 over ~10m. Release v3.2.1. Release notes: https://go/release/v3.2.1 :rocket:

deploy-bot: deploy started — router shift plan loaded. Steps: [10,25,50,100] every 2.5m. Command: `shift-traffic --route router/main --from=blue --to=green --steps=10,25,50,100 --hold=monitor`

Matt: Keep session-affinity for existing sessions. Monitor p50/p95/p99 + error-rate. If p95 > 750ms or 5xx > 0.5% -> hold and call rollback.

deploy-bot: step 10% complete. Green healthy: replicas 12/12. avg p95 460ms.

Leo: saw a small uptick in p95 in eu-west right after step 25.

deploy-bot: step 25% complete. p95 720ms in eu-west, global p95 485ms.

SRE Oncall: @Anya hold at 25%. tail looks higher in eu-west, can we run a canary probe? :eyes:

Anya: Holding. Kicking off canary harness: `scripts/canary/load.sh --env green --dur 30s`

Jamie: Quick logs look like KV-cache miss rate ~2.9% higher on green. Might be kernel/codepath change for quantized ops.

Matt: Option: pin eu-west to the v2 model variant on router while other regions continue to green. That isolates the regression.

Anya: Can we route 100% of eu-west back to blue and continue roll for others? If yes, do it.

deploy-bot: applying route override: 
```
route set router/main region=eu-west -> blue --sticky
```
... done.

deploy-bot: eu-west reverted to blue, global still at 25% green.

Leo: After override p95 eu-west dropped to 420ms. Global p95 now 490ms.

Matt: 5xx on green 0.3% — currently under threshold. Still watchful. If 5xx >= 0.5% full rollback.

Anya: Decision: continue rollout for non-eu regions to 50% but keep eu-west pinned to blue. Next step in 5m, will run another probe before moving to 100%. Updating release notes with pin.

deploy-bot: holding for probe. Next scheduled shift in 5m.

deploy-bot: (after probe) step 50% complete (eu-west override still in place). Green metrics: p95 510ms, 5xx 0.28%.

SRE Oncall: Good. Keep a 1h quiet-watch in the change window and open follow-on for runtime investigation into cache warming.

Anya: Created ticket INC-2541, assigned to eng-runtime to dig into KV-cache mismatch and kernel selection. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: rollout partially complete. Final step will be scheduled after monitoring window. If any region breaches thresholds, rollback command is `shift-traffic --route router/main --to=blue --force`.
